verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a native event replay or backfill feature. It does show that Segment can archive raw event data to Data Storage Destinations (warehouses, S3, GCS) and that Reverse ETL can sync warehouse data out to third-party destinations. Together these allow a workaround backfill path into a newly added tool, but only via the warehouse and with extra setup. Missing for 10: a native replay of archived events into a new destination, documented backfill or recovery after pipeline breaks, controls over replay scope or time ranges, and hands-on corroboration.
